script_text: Something tectonic is shifting beneath you, Pluto-ruled Water sign Scorpio, and this week it will erupt. Your Pluto-ruled Water essence must feel it deeply. Early this week, Mercury squares Pluto while the Full Moon in your 8th house magnifies secrets, trust, and shared resources. Monday and Tuesday may sting with power struggles at work or in love, but Wednesday becomes your power day because Venus enters your 5th house, igniting creative flirtation and bold romance. Midweek, Jupiter trines your 10th house, turning hidden ambition into public opportunity. Late week, Mars opposes your 7th house, testing intimate bonds, while weekend Jupiter expands your 2nd house of money. Best day: Wednesday, because Venus enters your 5th house. Worst day: Monday, because Mercury square Pluto blocks honest communication. This placement asks for deep courage. Weekly advice: release control slowly instead of forcing emotional intensity. Follow for daily updates.
